events.info: Kick off the holiday season with a Madison tradition in the making. Join Mr. Chair, the Wisconsin Chamber Orchestra, and members of Madison Youth Choirs for a festive celebration inspired by Vince Guaraldi Trio's beloved "A Charlie Brown Christmas". Hear the iconic album performed live in its entirety with new orchestral string arrangements that preserve the timeless jazz spirit of these holiday favorites and enjoy beloved seasonal classics that will have audiences of all ages embracing the magic of the season. Gather the people you love and make this unforgettable evening part of your holiday celebration. Bags (max size 12" x 6" x 12") are allowed and will be searched upon entry. We encourage you to pack light with only the necessities to make the entry process as smooth as possible. There are no elevators in the Theater. Accessible Seating: Available online through Ticketmaster by filtering on the ADA Icon and selecting the Accessible Seats, or in person at the box office.
